import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
for c in cands:
    d = df.dropna(subset=[c,'tensile_mpa'])
    m = smf.ols(f'tensile_mpa ~ {c} + C(lab)', data=d).fit()
    print(f"{c:14s} coef={m.params[c]:+.4f} se={m.bse[c]:.4f} p={m.pvalues[c]:.4f} n={int(m.nobs)}")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
# cool_rate by lab
print(df.groupby('lab')['cool_rate'].describe())
print(df.groupby('lab')['tensile_mpa'].mean())
# correlation of cool_rate with other candidates
print(df[cands].corr()['cool_rate'].sort_values())
# full model with all candidates
d = df.dropna(subset=cands+['tensile_mpa'])
m = smf.ols('tensile_mpa ~ ' + ' + '.join(cands) + ' + C(lab)', data=d).fit()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
d = df.dropna(subset=['cool_rate','tensile_mpa'])
# robust (HC3) and check nonlinearity
m = smf.ols('tensile_mpa ~ cool_rate + C(lab)', data=d).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print("HC3 p:", m.pvalues['cool_rate'], "coef", m.params['cool_rate'])
# add quadratic
d2 = d.copy(); d2['cr2']=d2['cool_rate']**2
m2 = smf.ols('tensile_mpa ~ cool_rate + cr2 + C(lab)', data=d2).fit()
print("quad p:", m2.pvalues['cr2'])
# binned means
d2['bin']=pd.qcut(d2['cool_rate'],5)
print(d2.groupby('bin',observed=True)['tensile_mpa'].mean())
# effect within each lab
for lab,g in d.groupby('lab'):
    mm=smf.ols('tensile_mpa ~ cool_rate',data=g).fit()
    print(lab, round(mm.params['cool_rate'],3), round(mm.pvalues['cool_rate'],3))
